tasks.description: Implement the domain entries `PasswordHash`, `PasswordHashError`, `OpaqueAccessToken`, `OpaqueAccessTokenError`, `User`, `AccessTokenRecord`, `UserRepository`, `AccessTokenRepository`, `UserRepositoryError`, `AccessTokenRepositoryError`, and `UserLookupError`, plus focused boundary and contract tests (IN-001, IN-002, CN-001, CN-002, AC-001, AC-002, AC-003).

Implement the usecase entries `PlaintextPassword`, `PasswordInputError`, `CredentialParseError`, `RegisterUserCommand`, `LoginCommand`, `PasswordHashingError`, `PasswordVerificationError`, `TokenIssuanceError`, `PasswordHasher`, `PasswordVerifier`, and `OpaqueTokenIssuer`, plus focused boundary tests (IN-001, IN-002, CN-001, CN-005, AC-001, AC-002, AC-003).
Implement the usecase entries `RegisterUserService`, `RegisterUserInteractor`, and `RegisterUserError`, plus result tests (IN-001, CN-001, CN-002, CN-005, AC-001, AC-003).
Implement the usecase entries `LoginService`, `LoginInteractor`, `LoginError`, and `IssuedAccessToken`, plus result tests (IN-002, CN-001, CN-002, CN-005, AC-002).

Implement the infrastructure entries `InMemoryUserRepository`, `InMemoryAccessTokenRepository`, `Argon2PasswordAdapter`, and `RandomOpaqueTokenIssuer`, plus repository and port-conformance tests (IN-001, IN-002, CN-001, CN-002, AC-001, AC-002, AC-003).

Implement the cli_driver entries `AuthHttpApi` and `HttpServerOutcome` as the shared axum HTTP foundation, plus focused server lifecycle, JSON rejection, and HTTP outcome tests (IN-001, IN-002, CN-003, CN-004).
Implement the cli_composition entry `AuthCompositionRoot`, plus focused wiring tests (IN-001, IN-002, CN-002, CN-003, AC-001, AC-002).

Implement the cli_driver entry `RegisterRequest` and wire the registration route into `AuthHttpApi`, plus focused registration request and HTTP behavior tests (IN-001, CN-003, CN-004, CN-005, AC-001).

Implement the cli_driver entries `LoginRequest` and `AccessTokenResponse` and wire the login/token route into `AuthHttpApi`, plus focused login request, token response, and HTTP behavior tests (IN-002, CN-003, CN-004, CN-005, AC-002).
